description: Adds native playable Sleeper and Drifter hulls with independent player type IDs, 8/8/8/3 slots, Lux Lance weapons, a dedicated Drifter doomsday, corrected resistance-module fitting for player hulls, Tyrannos bonus info, and native fitting-simulation FSD resources.
readme: 本模组包含服务端加载器、客户端 FSD 数据、服务端静态表和安装器。目标是让玩家使用根据原版流浪者冬眠者舰船添加的模组舰船。
changelog:
增加了舰船加成说明
修复了勒克斯之矛无法获得加成的问题
修复了并组武器只有一组伤害的问题
